title: Artifactory health per pod and Service
description: What each pod of the workload, and each Service selecting those pods, answered on Artifactory's liveness and readiness, the router's health document and the router's own liveness and readiness through the API server's proxy. ok is true for the expected payload, false for a 503, an unhealthy router state or a pod's liveness or readiness answering 404, null when nothing usable came back.

serviceCount.description: Services whose selector matches the pod template's labels

servicesRead.description: false when listing Services was forbidden: serviceCount is then 0 and says nothing

truncated.description: pods or Services were cut at maxItems

notOkCount.description: endpoints (pods and Services) whose ok is false

podReady.description: the pod's Ready condition (the kubelet's probe, which may not be these endpoints)

queried.description: false for a pod that is not Running (or beyond the first 10), or a Service beyond the first 10; not asked

liveness.description: null when the pod or Service was not asked, or a Service does not expose the port

port.description: the container port (pod) or Service port (Service) asked

httpStatus.description: 200, 401, 403, 404 or 503; null when the ask failed (see errors) or the reply was not the expected payload

served.description: false for a 404 (nothing serves the path there); null when the ask failed

ok.description: true for a 200 with the expected payload (and, for the router health, every state HEALTHY); false for a 503, a router health document with a state that is not HEALTHY, or a pod's liveness or readiness answering 404 (see reason); null otherwise

authRequired.description: Artifactory answered 401 or 403: it wants credentials, which the skill does not send

noEndpoints.description: a Service with no ready endpoint (the API server's 503)

reason.description: set on a pod's liveness or readiness that answered 404 (ok is false): the path is not served on that port (the pod is booting, the port is wrong, or the workload is not Artifactory)

body.description: the OK text of a liveness or readiness 200: OK, or a JSON document whose code is OK

router.description: the router health document of a 200

unhealthyCount.description: services whose state is not HEALTHY
